public void rewriteCustomer(String projectOrderId, String contractCode, Map<String, String> fieldKeyValueMap) {
		ContractUser customer = contractUserService.getUserByContractCodeAndType(contractCode, UserTypeEnum.OWNER.getCode());
		String customerName = Objects.nonNull(customer) ? customer.getName() : "";
		RewriteParam param = RewriteParam.builder()
			.projectOrderId(projectOrderId)
			.customerName(customerName)
			.resblockName(fieldKeyValueMap.get("resblockName"))
			.buildingName(fieldKeyValueMap.get("buildingName"))
			.unitName(fieldKeyValueMap.get("unitName"))
			.floorName(fieldKeyValueMap.get("floorName"))
			.houseName(fieldKeyValueMap.get("houseName"))
			.districtName(fieldKeyValueMap.get("districtName"))
			.parlorCnt(fieldKeyValueMap.get("parlorCnt"))
			.cookroomCnt(fieldKeyValueMap.get("cookroomCnt"))
			.toiletCnt(fieldKeyValueMap.get("toiletCnt"))
			.roomCnt(fieldKeyValueMap.get("roomCnt"))
			.balconyCnt(fieldKeyValueMap.get("balconyCnt"))
			.storageCnt(fieldKeyValueMap.get("storageCnt"))
			.area(fieldKeyValueMap.get("area"))
			.resblockId(fieldKeyValueMap.get("resblockId"))
			.buildingId(fieldKeyValueMap.get("buildingId"))
			.unitId(fieldKeyValueMap.get("unitId"))
			.floorId(fieldKeyValueMap.get("floorId"))
			.houseId(fieldKeyValueMap.get("houseId"))
			.districtId(fieldKeyValueMap.get("districtId"))
			.propertyType(fieldKeyValueMap.get("houseType"))
			.decorateType(fieldKeyValueMap.get("decorateForm"))
			.build();

		if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(fieldKeyValueMap.get("houseBuildType")) && Objects.nonNull(HouseBuildTypeEnum.getEnumByCode(Integer.valueOf(fieldKeyValueMap.get("houseBuildType"))))) {
			HouseBuildTypeEnum houseBuildTypeEnum = HouseBuildTypeEnum.getEnumByCode(Integer.valueOf(fieldKeyValueMap.get("houseBuildType")));
			param.setFrameStructure(CommissionHouseBuildTypeEnum.convertToCommissionHouseBuildType(houseBuildTypeEnum).toString());
		}
		CompletableFuture.runAsync(RunnableWrapper.of(() -> commonContractService.rewriteCustomerAndNotify(param)));
	}

private ContractReqDTO buildContractSubmitReq(Contract contract) {
		ContractUser legalUser = contractUserService.getLatestUserByRole(contract.getContractCode(), RoleTypeEnum.LEGAL.getCode());
		ContractUser companyAgentUser = contractUserService.getLatestUserByRole(contract.getContractCode(), RoleTypeEnum.COMPANY_AGENT.getCode());
		Map<String, String> contractFieldMap = contractFieldService.getFieldMap(contract.getContractCode());

		return ContractReqDTO.builder()
			.contractBaseInfo(ContractBaseInfoReq.builder()
				.projectOrderId(contract.getProjectOrderId())
				.contractType(ContractTypeEnum.ACCREDIT.getCode())
				.submitCompanyCode(contract.getCompanyCode())
				.build())
			.signInfo(ContractSignInfoReq.builder()
				.contractObjectType(ContractObjectTypeEnum.COMPANY.getCode())
				.signChannelType(SignChannelTypeEnum.ONLINE.getCode())
				.userSignType(UserSignTypeEnum.SIGN.getCode())
				.companyName(contractFieldMap.get("companyName"))
				.companyCreditCode(contractFieldMap.get("companyCreditCode"))
				.registeredAddress(contractFieldMap.get("registeredAddress"))
				.signCompanyCode(contract.getCompanyCode())
				.signRole(RoleTypeEnum.LEGAL.getCode())
				.legalName(legalUser.getName())
				.legalPhone(legalUser.getPhone())
				.legalCertificateType(legalUser.getCertificateType())
				.legalCertificateNo(legalUser.getCertificateNo())
				.companyAgentName(Optional.ofNullable(companyAgentUser).map(ContractUser::getName).orElse(null))
				.companyAgentPhone(Optional.ofNullable(companyAgentUser).map(ContractUser::getPhone).orElse(null))
				.companyAgentCertificateType(Optional.ofNullable(companyAgentUser).map(ContractUser::getCertificateType).orElse(null))
				.companyAgentCertificateNo(Optional.ofNullable(companyAgentUser).map(ContractUser::getCertificateNo).orElse(null))
				.build())
			.projectInfo(ContractProjectInfoReq.builder()
				.businessType(contract.getBusinessType())
				.gbCode(Integer.valueOf(contractFieldMap.get("gbCode")))
				.gbName(contractFieldMap.get("gbName"))
				.districtName(contractFieldMap.get("districtName"))
				.resblockName(contractFieldMap.get("resblockName"))
				.buildingName(contractFieldMap.get("buildingName"))
				.unitName(contractFieldMap.get("unitName"))
				.floorName(contractFieldMap.get("floorName"))
				.houseName(contractFieldMap.get("houseName"))
				.build())
			.businessInfo(BusinessInfoDetail.builder()
				.decorateType(contract.getBusinessType().toString())
				.build())
			.build();
	}

public Contract buildContract(BaseContractDto baseContractDto, String companyCode, ContractCityCompanyInfo config, Byte businessType) {
		//线下补录
		byte userSignStatus = SignChannelTypeEnum.OFFLINE.getCode().equals(baseContractDto.getSignChannelType()) ? CommonEnum.YES.getCode() : CommonEnum.NO.getCode();
		return Contract.builder()
			.contractCode(RandomCodeUtils.generateContractCode())
			.contractNo(RandomCodeUtils.generateContractNo())
			.userSignType(baseContractDto.getUserSignType())
			.type(baseContractDto.getType())
			.gbCode(baseContractDto.getGbCode())
			.companyCode(companyCode)
			.signChannelType(baseContractDto.getSignChannelType())
			.userSignStatus(userSignStatus)
			.projectOrderId(baseContractDto.getProjectOrderId())
			.businessType(businessType)
			.auditType(config.getAuditType().byteValue())
			.amount(BigDecimal.valueOf(Objects.isNull(baseContractDto.getAmount()) ? 0 : baseContractDto.getAmount()))
			.createUserId(baseContractDto.getCreateUserId())
			.createUserName(baseContractDto.getCreateUserName())
			.modifyUserId(baseContractDto.getModifyUserId())
			.modifyUserName(baseContractDto.getModifyUserName())
			.build();
	}
